description: A Trade Association Initiative Is Expanding Critical Workforce Skills in Multiple States is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Flood Mitigation Industry Association. The Flood Mitigation Industry Association is addressing an urgent shortage of workers skilled in elevating buildings above flood levels and sealing buildings that cannot be elevated by creating training programs for entry-level jobs in good-paying, high-demand careers. Coverage: Coastal Louisiana (2025). The toolkit gives Coastal Louisiana as the location, 2025 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
